verdict.rationale: The README explicitly offers both scopes: copy the skill folder into your personal (all-projects) skills directory or into a project skills directory. A plugin-marketplace install is also available. The scope choice is supported but documented in a single line, with no detail on how each option works. missing for 10: explicit directory paths for each scope, guidance on committing the project-local copy to the repo, how plugin-marketplace install scope maps to project vs. user, independent or hands-on corroboration.
